label: Epoxy · self-leveling industrial (neutral light grey, semi-gloss)

candidates_considered: /Volumes/SAMSUNG 1TB/ФФото Виде материалы терраццо/Terrazo /проект 2/IMG_2298.PNG (light-grey semi-gloss quartz floor, but AI-render look, 1024px, heavy window reflections)
source.selection_reason: The archive contains NO clean face-on flat photo of a smooth light epoxy floor. This 6719x3649 professional photo of grey epoxy-resin being applied has the largest clean expanse of freshly self-leveled mid-grey resin in its lower-left quadrant — genuinely the right material (self-leveling epoxy, semi-gloss). The проект 2 light-grey gloss floors are the iconic look but are 1024px AI-style renders shot at extreme oblique angles with baked window reflections (unusable as flat sources).
source.crop_reason: Lower-left clean self-leveled resin patch, fewest specks/bubbles; pure smooth surface with only a low-frequency lighting gradient (no hard geometry) — ideal for de-lighting.

material_truth.fillers: Mostly solid epoxy resin (self-leveling). No aggregate in this product; only sparse trapped air-bubbles / pin-specks visible. (Optional quartz-broadcast or vinyl flakes exist as variants but are NOT in this pilot texture.)
material_truth.matrix: Pigmented epoxy resin, neutral light grey.
material_truth.finish: Self-leveling, semi-gloss to gloss (aliphatic PU topcoat). Smooth — near-zero surface relief.
material_truth.manufacturer_recipe: Sika Sikafloor-263 SL — self-leveling epoxy 3-5 mm over Sikafloor-156 primer on C25/30 concrete, finished with Sikafloor-264 PU topcoat for the semi-gloss sheen. (Sikafloor-264 is the gloss/UV-stable seal; 263 SL is the body.) Matches the manifest buildup already on file.

colour.note: Near-uniform surface, so matrix hex = de-lit overall mean. The original source had a strong cool/blue ambient cast (raw de-lit mean #44515a, dark+blue); de-lighting flattened the gradient and the albedo was then grey-world neutralised and retargeted to a believable neutral light-grey resin (#9c9b98). Current manifest swatch is near-black #2a2620 — recommend updating to a neutral light grey, or keep dark via the configurator colour control.

scale.physical_mm_per_tile: Scale-agnostic — a near-uniform surface has no aggregate to size against. The 2048px master maps to roughly 600-900 mm but reads identically at any repeat.
scale.tile_note: Manifest 'tile' is an integer repeat. Current value 2 is fine; even tile=1 works because the surface is uniform. Keep 2.

gloss.note: Semi-gloss epoxy in the 0.15-0.3 target band. roughness.png mean 0.232, very tight range (uniform sheen). Procedural roughness on file is 0.15 (fuller gloss) — both are defensible; 0.20-0.23 reads as semi-gloss, 0.15 as gloss.

normal.png.strength: gen-pbr bump 1.5 (capped flat); R channel range 121-134 i.e. ~+-7 of 128 — essentially flat, correct for smooth resin

processing.decode: sips JPG->extract 1800px square -> lanczos3 upscale to 2048 (UPSCALED from 1800px).
processing.delight: sharp divide-by-heavy-blur (sigma=341, blurDiv 6) re-multiplied by channel means; then tight high-pass (blur radius width/12) to remove residual mid-frequency tonal blobs while keeping fine specks/grain (gain 0.8); grey-world neutralise + retarget mean to #9c9b98.
processing.seamless: Toroidal (2x2-mosaic) low-frequency flatten so the large-scale field is seamless, then separable wrap edge-blend on the 5% borders. NO 50% roll / clone-patch was used — on a near-uniform surface that introduced a repeating signature; the toroidal+edge-blend approach tiles cleanly with no internal motif. Validated by 2x2 tiling.
processing.pbr: scripts/gen-pbr-maps.js epoxy --root=3d-assets/textures-v4 (bump 1.5 capped, baseRough 0.25, chipsSmooth false, ao 0.4).

caveats: Source master was UPSCALED from an 1800px crop to 2048px (lanczos3).

Source had a strong cool/blue ambient cast and a steep lighting gradient; both were removed in processing. The result is an idealised neutral grey resin rather than a 1:1 colour match of the original lit photo.

2x2 tiling shows a very faint soft tonal undulation at the seam (no hard line, no repeating feature). On a semi-gloss floor where reflections dominate the read, this is invisible at render scale. Acceptable for a near-uniform material.
No quartz/flake variant produced — this is the plain self-leveling resin look only.

recommended_manifest.palette_note: neutral light-grey resin, lighter sheen tint, mid-grey, darker shade variant
recommended_manifest.note: Repoint pbr.* from textures/epoxy/* to textures-v4/epoxy/* to use this new set. If keeping the dark swatch #2a2620, the diffuse here is light-grey — pick one direction (light texture vs dark swatch) for consistency. (Orchestrator applies — do not edit manifest here.)
